sources.snippet: Fine-tuning AraT5v2 for Arabic extractive question answering using parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA / PEFT). Trained and evaluated on a SQuAD-style Arabic QA dataset. The model learns to extract short answer spans from a given Arabic context passage.
